aboutUsHtml:
About ColoringTool.com

Welcome to ColoringTool.com, the premier online destination for free, safe, and engaging digital coloring activities for young children ages 3 to 10. Our mission is to empower children to unleash their imagination, discover colors, and build fine motor skills through playful, accessible creative tools directly in their web browser.

Our Creative Philosophy

Drawing and painting are essential to early childhood cognitive development. At ColoringTool.com, we design every illustration with bold contours and engaging themes so children can feel immediate pride and joy in their artwork. Whether filling regions with tap-to-fill or experimenting with digital brushes, children can express their unique visual voice without mess or complexity.

Safe, Screen-Positive Experience

We strictly follow child-safe design standards. There are no mandatory logins, no account creations, and no downloads required. All drawing activities are completely anonymous, instant, and privacy-first.

Co-Viewing & Shared Connection

Our activities are crafted for children and parents, teachers, and caregivers to explore together. Talking about colors, naming animals, and sharing storytelling around each drawing transforms digital time into meaningful connection and learning.
privacyPolicyHtml:
Privacy Policy — ColoringTool.com

Last Updated: November 15, 2026

At ColoringTool.com, we are committed to providing a fun, educational, and safe environment for all our visitors, especially children and their families. This Privacy Policy details our transparent data practices and compliance with global standards, including the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), GDPR, and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).

1. Children's Privacy (COPPA Compliance)

Protecting children's online privacy is our highest priority. ColoringTool.com is designed for general audiences and child-directed use. In strict compliance with COPPA:

  • We do not collect personal information (such as real names, home addresses, email addresses, or phone numbers) from children under the age of 13.
  • Users can access 100% of our coloring pages and games completely anonymously without registration or sign-up.

2. Third-Party Advertising & Google AdSense Compliance

To keep our coloring games 100% free for children, parents, and schools worldwide, we display advertising through trusted partners such as Google AdSense.

  • Google AdSense & Cookies: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites.
  • Advertising Cookies: Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visits to our site and/or other sites across the Internet.
  • Opting Out: Users may opt out of personalized advertising at any time by visiting Google Ads Settings. Alternatively, users can opt out of third-party vendor use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting www.aboutads.info.
  • Non-Personalized Ads for Kids: For child-directed pages and users, ads are served contextually and non-personalized in compliance with Google's child-directed advertising guidelines.

3. Browser Local Storage

When you use the "My Art Gallery" feature to save colored drawings, the drawing image data is stored strictly in your device's web browser local storage. We do not upload, transmit, or store your artwork on external servers.

4. Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our practices, please contact our team at privacy@coloringtool.com.
